about: IDs that a companion specification proposes and the spine does not register. GATE-links reports each as pending, not as a failure, while its entry is here. W0-T10 (spine revision 3) registers or declines each ID and then deletes its entry; `node scripts/verify-links.mjs --strict` fails while any entry remains. An entry is itself a failure once the spine registers its ID, or once nothing that is scanned uses it. Run IDs that a task lists in proposed_ids are pending through tracker/tasks.yaml and are not repeated here.
